workflow.name: Find meetings
workflow.instructions: Find the person's upcoming sales meetings. Use a connected calendar add-on if there is one, otherwise ask the person to paste the meetings. Write each meeting's time, company and attendees to outputs/meetings.md.

workflow.name: Research accounts
workflow.instructions: Read outputs/meetings.md. For each company, research the company, its attendees, its main competitors and what those competitors are doing lately. Write the findings with links to outputs/research.md.

workflow.name: Talking points
workflow.instructions: Read outputs/meetings.md and outputs/research.md. For each meeting, explain why the company needs Bees to stay competitive, then list talking points ranked by how likely each is to make the sale, with a one-line reason each. Write it to outputs/meeting-prep.md and reply with the top three points per meeting.
